title: Eye Diagram
text: (Removed) Display eye diagram of time-domain signal, 1 input, no direct feedthrough, {Oversampling method} sets Oversampling method; {Display mode}, {Enable measurements}, {Show horizontal (jitter) histogram} displays jitter histogram, {Show vertical (noise) histogram} displays noise histogram, {Do not show horizontal or vertical histogram}, {Show horizontal bathtub curve}, {Show vertical bathtub curve}, {Eye diagram to display}, {Color fading}, {Samples per symbol}, {Sample offset}, {Symbols per trace}, {Traces to display} sets the number of traces to display, {Title}, {Show grid} sets the toggle scope grid, {Y-limits (Minimum)} sets the lower limit of y -axis, {Y-limits (Maximum)} sets the upper limit of y -axis, {Real axis label}, {Imaginary axis label}, {Color scale}, {Export measurements, histograms and bathtub curves}, {Variable name}, {Figure color}, {Axes colors}, {Line}, {Marker} sets the data point marker, {Colormap}, {Eye level boundaries} sets the time range for calculating eye levels, {Decision boundary} sets the amplitude level threshold, {Rise/Fall thresholds} sets the amplitude levels of the rise and fall transitions, {Hysteresis} sets the amplitude tolerance of the horizontal, {BER threshold} sets the bER used for eye, {Bathtub BERs} sets the bER values used to calculate openings of bathtub curves and {Measurement delay} sets the duration of initial data discarded. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Display mode
params.values: Display mode Line plot (default) | 2D color Histogram

params.name: Do not show horizontal or vertical histogram
params.values: Do not show horizontal or vertical histogram on (default) | off

params.name: Show horizontal bathtub curve
params.values: Show horizontal bathtub curve off (default) | on

params.name: Show vertical bathtub curve
params.values: Show vertical bathtub curve off (default) | on

params.name: Eye diagram to display
params.values: Eye diagram to display Real only (default) | Real and imaginary

params.name: Traces to display
params.values: Number of traces to display 40 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Oversampling method
params.values: Oversampling method None (default) | Input interpolation | Histogram interpolation

params.name: Export measurements, histograms and bathtub curves
params.values: Export measurements, histograms and bathtub curves Off (default) | off

params.name: Line
params.values: Line style, thickness and color for line plots continuous | 0.5 | yellow (default)

params.name: Colormap
params.values: Colormap for histograms Hot (default) | Parula | Jet | HSV | Cool | Spring Summer | Autumn | Winter | Gray | Bone | Copper | Pink | Lines | Custom

params.name: Eye level boundaries
params.values: Time range for calculating eye levels [40 60] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Rise/Fall thresholds
params.values: Amplitude levels of the rise and fall transitions [10 90] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Hysteresis
params.values: Amplitude tolerance of the horizontal crossings 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: BER threshold
params.values: BER used for eye measurements 1e-12 (default) | nonnegative scalar from 0 to 0.5

params.name: Bathtub BERs
params.values: BER values used to calculate openings of bathtub curves [0.5 0.1 0.01 0.001 0.0001 1e-05 1e-06 1e-07 1e-08 1e-09 1e-10 1e-11 1e-12] (default) | vector

params.name: Measurement delay
params.values: Duration of initial data discarded from measurements 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar
